text:
Rhea: Hey team I'm resigning effective today. Planning my last day as 2025-04-30. Can someone kick off offboarding? I have a few odd items: a partial month of RSU/option vesting question, archived mailbox request (need 2 years preserved for audits), return of a hardware HSM token + laptop, and COBRA timing.
Sam (People Ops): Sorry to see you go, Rhea. Quick bullets: benefits end EOD 2025-04-30. COBRA packet will be emailed/mailed within 14 business days after coverage end; election window usually 60 days. For RSUs/options, comp will follow the equity plan rules  we'll loop in Comp/Finance. Do you want HR to request mailbox export and place a 2-year retention hold?
Rhea: Yes please place retention hold and export. Also: will my partial-month PTO payout be prorated? And any caveats for the RSU cliff that hits on 2025-05-15 (a couple weeks after my last day)?
Sam (People Ops): PTO payout = payroll rules (prorated)  Payroll will confirm timing. Regarding RSUs/options: comp confirms that grants vesting after your termination date are generally forfeited unless you have an exit clause; if there's an exception for termination without cause we will check. I'll ping Finance & Comp now.
Payroll: FYI -- payroll notified. Final paycheck (including accrued PTO) will be processed on the next cycle; will email expected date and gross/net breakdown.
Eli (IT): Please confirm asset info so we can generate a prepaid FedEx label. We'll schedule secure wipe after final day and coordinate HSM token return. If the HSM is a separate device, we'll require signature upon receipt.
Rhea: Confirmed asset tag RDN-09999. HSM token is company-owned and currently in my desk safe. I can drop both at SF locker or ship. Also: I have a long-lived deploy key used for an internal analytics pipeline; want to make sure rotation happens before deprovision.
Security: We'll do an access audit on 2025-05-01 09:00 PT and revoke SSO/org credentials after confirmation. Please list any service or deploy keys you manage so we can coordinate rotations. We'll also coordinate with Infra to escrow customer encryption keys if needed.
Rhea: For the customer keys: I manage a team-owned KMS alias used by two services. I do not hold raw keys, but we should escrow the alias access. I'll add notes to the handoff doc and tag @Infra in the doc.
Sam (People Ops): Exit interview  quick 30-min slot? We can do 2025-05-05 morning. We'll also request a standard separation acknowledgement and send COBRA & benefits packet within 14 business days of 4/30.
Rhea: 05/05 morning works. One last question: can payroll provide a written estimate for COBRA monthly premium amounts so I can plan?
Payroll: We can attach estimated premium ranges in the COBRA packet, but final premiums come from the carrier. We'll include contact info for each carrier and an estimate based on your current plan enrollment.
Eli (IT): FedEx label created once you confirm shipping preference. Default action: schedule secure wipe 2025-05-01 10:00 PT (business day after last day). If you want the wipe later, let us know.
Rhea: Ship label please. And please don't wipe until we've completed the handoff sessions on 04/29. I'll schedule two 30-min walkthroughs next week and upload runbooks.
Security: Noted. We'll delay automatic wipe until 2025-04-30 18:00 PT and confirm after handoffs. We'll still rotate any deploy keys that need immediate rotation prior to wipe.
Sam (People Ops): Sending DM with locker code and the FedEx label once created. Exit interview invite (2025-05-05 10:30 PT) sent. Comp/Finance looped for RSU/option question; expect update in 2 business days. COBRA materials + asset return instructions will be emailed within 14 business days of 2025-04-30. Thanks, Rhea.
Rhea: Thanks everyone  appreciate the quick responses and help with escrow/retention.
